title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30223: add IsHandled events to Purchase Line (translation, price calc, WMS)
summary: Three new IsHandled integration events are added to the Purchase Line table, enabling extensions to intervene in item translation, location-based price calculation, and WMS location checks.
key_points: OnCopyFromItemOnBeforeGetItemTranslation lets subscribers skip the standard item translation call in CopyFromItem
OnValidateLocationCodeOnBeforePlanPriceCalcByField passes Rec, xRec and CurrFieldNo so subscribers can replace price planning on Location Code validation
OnBeforeCheckWMS lets subscribers bypass the standard WMS location check
Changes applied in W1 and propagated to the Purchase Line table in all other BaseApp layers
